title: AIM runtime state
description: Canonical, resumable checkpoint for one active AIM Epic. Project-specific extension fields are allowed but cannot replace canonical fields.

activeIncrementId.description: Canonical DI identifier, or null before Gate B.

plannedIncrementId.description: Optional canonical DI identity reserved by a Portfolio-aware start before Gate B. It is not active or approved runtime authority.

previousIncrementId.description: Optional canonical identity of the most recently transitioned Increment when activeIncrementId is null.

previousIncrementStatus.description: Optional explicit status for previousIncrementId. AIM UI recognizes the exact value accepted only with a valid Gate E checkpoint and linked evidence.

gateEAcceptance.description: Optional repository-relative POSIX path to contained Gate E acceptance evidence for previousIncrementId.

epicClosureEvidence.description: Repository-relative POSIX path to contained truth-audit JSON required by the canonical Epic closure transition.

epicClosureEvidenceSha256.description: SHA-256 binding to the exact epicClosureEvidence artifact accepted by the canonical closure transition.

epicClosureEvidenceSetSha256.description: Deterministic SHA-256 binding to every distinct referenced evidence path, kind, size, and current file digest used by the canonical closure transition.
